🌎 ➡️ Climate and Environmental Advice for California’s Next Governor California’s next Governor will face complex challenges, from increasing threats of climate change-driven disaster and a federal administration hostile to environmental protection to a significant climate infrastructure backlog. At the same time, Californians are experiencing increased energy, insurance, and other household costs while also facing growing environmental threats to health and well-being. Working with dozens of expert partners, CLEE has developed a #Roadmap for California’s next Governor to tackle these complex issues, including sections on: energy transition, electricity affordability, wildfire resilience, and water sustainability. 🗺️ Access the Report: https://lnkd.in/gCrt2G8R 📑 Lead Authors: Louise Bedsworth Ted Lamm Ken Alex University of California, Berkeley - School of Law #Climate #climatepolicy
Check out Louise Bedsworth 's blog post on the development of this roadmap: https://legal-planet.org/2026/10/29/sharing-our-advice-with-californias-next-governor /
